description: greplost: keep the committed structure map (.greplost/) current and point agents at it before they grep.

hooks.command: sh -c 'if command -v greplost >/dev/null 2>&1; then greplost hook session-start; else bunx greplost hook session-start; fi'
sh -c 'if command -v greplost >/dev/null 2>&1; then greplost hook pre-tool-use; else bunx greplost hook pre-tool-use; fi'
sh -c 'if command -v greplost >/dev/null 2>&1; then greplost hook post-tool-use; else bunx greplost hook post-tool-use; fi'
sh -c 'if command -v greplost >/dev/null 2>&1; then greplost hook stop; else bunx greplost hook stop; fi'
